item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"answers":[{"id":"Q1","answer":"Initial-stage Super Saturated hydration support comes from A04, A08, and A09. A04 reports Super Saturated as very hydrating, lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying, and not pore-clogging. A08 reports skin left very hydrated when Super Saturated was paired with tretinoin and other actives. A09 reports hydration being locked in when Avant Guard was used over Super Saturated, but that is a joint-use, non-separable mask-plus-serum account, not isolated Super Saturated efficacy. No clinical, ingredient, formula-version, population, or causal claim is supported.","source_accounts":["A04","A08","A09"],"limitations":["Initial-stage frozen ledger only; no raw-source rescue or outside validation.","A09 is joint-use and non-separable between Avant Guard and Super Saturated.","A08 includes co-use with tretinoin and other actives.","Mask fit and star deduction remain Avant Guard-only, not Super Saturated hydration evidence."]},{"id":"Q2","answer":"Initial-stage Super Saturated texture support has two direct firsthand accounts: A03 and A04. A03 directly compares Regimen Lab Wave Serum as less sticky than Super Saturated, while still using Super Saturated because the author believes it has a little more glycerin; the glycerin point is uncertain and not verified, but the stickiness comparison is still direct texture testimony. A04 reports Super Saturated as lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying, not leaving pores feeling clogged, and suitable before makeup. There are no retained untried or predicted Super Saturated texture comparisons, so texture_speculative is empty. A11 reports stocking up on Softwear during months of liking it, with three unopened tubes remaining; tube quantity is not counted as separate assertions.
